description: This file defines the ProductImageService interface, which declares methods for managing product images in an e-commerce application, including adding, retrieving, and removing images, as well as saving or updating image records.

classes.name: ProductImageService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService, defining methods for handling product images including adding, retrieving, removing, and updating images, tailored for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the database and CMS, associating it with the specified product.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image content and description from CMS for a given image and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific product.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specified product image from storage.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductImage entity.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image file based on store code, product code, filename, and size, for use by the image servlet.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple product images to a product.
